summary: Solesence, Inc. filed an 8-K regarding a Settlement Agreement between its subsidiary Sol'sence, LLC and Refy Beauty Ltd. The agreement resolves disputes over consumer care products and requires Sol'sence to pay the GBP equivalent of $938,000 in twelve monthly installments of ~$78k, with the first due August 5, 2026. The parties also agreed to a six-month exclusivity period to develop a new SPF product; if a supply agreement is signed, the final six payments become credits toward product purchases. This is a routine legal settlement and product development arrangement, not a special-situation corporate event. No deal terms for an M&A or capital transaction are present.
